question: What is claimed to have been told to the addressee regarding the practice of the soul?
premises: This practice of the soul is told to you.
It is told again to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
